verdict.line: You lose if you let Camille poke you down with W (Tactical Sweep) and Q (Precision Protocol) resets while you're stuck away from walls; you win if you force extended brawls near tentacle terrain, where the 52.3% win rate over 625 games and Illaoi's solo-kill edge play out.

brief.thesis: Camille wants short, mobile trades punctuated by E (Hookshot) resets and Q (Precision Protocol) pokes; Illaoi wants long, stationary brawls where tentacles and Passive lifesteal accumulate. Every cooldown you force her to burn on repositioning instead of damage is a cooldown that doesn't come back for 12-16 seconds, and that's the whole matchup.

theirWindow.what: This is when Camille can engage off a wall, knock you up, and if level 6+ lock you in place with R (The Hextech Ultimatum) while autos deal bonus magic damage. Respect this window — don't overextend past minion wave if you can't answer the knockup.

yourWindow.what: For the next 12-16 seconds (scales with rank) she has no gap-closer or escape off a wall. Walk up, land W (Harsh Lesson) to leap onto her and pull tentacles into the fight, then hold E (Test of Spirit) to force the vessel timer — she cannot hookshot away from the spirit tether.

start.why: Highest win rate start (56.2% over 463 games) and the sustain from the potion lets you contest early trades near walls without a back.

boots.why: Most-picked and highest-winning boots (54% over 498 games); Camille's autos and Q (Precision Protocol) empowered hits are physical damage, so the flat reduction directly blunts her trade pattern.

core.why: First item in the most successful build path (59.6% over 89 games); the armor shred rewards the extended brawls tentacles are built for.
Second in the same core path; the proc gives you a slow to actually land W (Harsh Lesson) leaps and keep her from kiting with Q's bonus move speed.
Third in the core path; the health and damage reduction buy you through Camille's R (The Hextech Ultimatum) burst window.

situational.when: she's building AP jungle/mid threats alongside her R's bonus magic damage on-hit
you're winning trades but dying to burst before your tentacles finish healing you back
you want a faster all-in spike instead of the sustained-fight core

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest win rate page (53.2% over the larger sample, 45.2% pick); Grasp rewards the exact stand-and-trade pattern tentacles create, and the permanent health growth outscales Camille's early poke.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the most-picked combo (56.5% pick, 53.8% win rate) and lets you reset after level-3 all-ins while keeping wave presence; Flash+Ignite (55.8% win rate) is the stronger pick specifically to close out the solo-kill advantage Illaoi already holds in this matchup if you're playing for an early kill.

playing.title: Fight only near walls
playing.detail: Your Passive tentacles only spawn on impassible terrain, so the lane brush and river walls are your damage source. Away from them you're just a melee champion eating Camille's poke for free.

playing.title: Punish committed E (Hookshot)
playing.detail: Once she hookshots off a wall to engage, she has no mobility for 12-16 seconds. Land W (Harsh Lesson) immediately to pull tentacles into the fight and hold the trade — she cannot disengage.

playing.title: Hold E (Test of Spirit) for the vessel
playing.detail: E's spirit tether echoes damage back to her and, if she dies or runs too far, turns her into a Vessel spawning tentacles. Use it the moment she commits to a trade, not on cooldown.

playing.title: Respect level 6-8 all-ins
playing.detail: Once she has R (The Hextech Ultimatum), her knockup-into-anchor-into-bonus-magic-damage combo hits much harder. Don't extend trades past the minion wave until you have Sterak's Gage or a clear tentacle advantage.

playing.title: Sequence your R around hers
playing.detail: Camille's R can negate your R (Leap of Faith) and interrupt tentacles from forming if she uses it on you first. Either stay out of her R's 475 range when you're about to ult, or wait until she's already used hers before committing yours.

playing.title: Track her Q recast timer
playing.detail: Q (Precision Protocol) does far more damage if she delays the recast — if she backs off after the first hit, she's baiting the empowered second auto. Don't chase into it; let the window pass.

playing.title: Freeze to deny E resets
playing.detail: With Presence of Mind and Grasp sustain you can hold a freeze near your tower-adjacent wall, denying her easy E (Hookshot) engages off the lane wall and forcing her to walk up into your tentacle range instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning — when to hold E, how to sequence ultimates, which walls to fight near — is my own read of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Stay near terrain with tentacles when Camille closes in with (E), and brawl after using [E]. After reaching level 6, Camille can negate [R] with her (R) as well as interrupt tentacles from forming. Try not to be in range of Camille’s (R), or use [R] after Camille uses (R).
